name: ai-toolkit
description: Claude Code plugins for Android, iOS, web, UI design review and formal PR review.

plugins.name: android-kit
plugins.description: Android playbooks (feature, bugfix, dependency uplift, run on emulator), a standards index, reviewer, researcher and verifier agents, and repo-agnostic guard hooks.

plugins.name: ios-kit
plugins.description: iOS playbooks (feature, bugfix, dependency uplift, run on simulator), an Apple standards index, and reviewer, researcher and verifier agents.

plugins.name: web-kit
plugins.description: Web playbooks for React, Next.js and TypeScript (feature, bugfix, run in a browser), a standards index, and reviewer, researcher and verifier agents.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Formal written PR review: standards-cited findings register, verdict, promotion-manifest checks, optional CI posting. Android, iOS, Spring Boot, React/Next.js and generic repos.

plugins.name: design-kit
plugins.description: Tiered UI design rules (HIG, Material 3, WCAG 2.2, house) with sources, rationale and platform APIs, and a UI reviewer agent that grades against them.

plugins.name: guard-kit
plugins.description: Repo-agnostic PreToolUse guard: blocks protected-branch and force pushes, destructive git, timeout wrappers, and edits to secrets, signing material and lock files. Limits the toolkit researcher and verifier agents to their documented commands.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Maintenance of the ai-toolkit repo itself. The audit skill re-checks every rule and reference against its cited source and proposes diffs without applying them. The check skill runs the pre-PR checks for the files a branch changes.
